business_summary.text: L&T Technology Services Limited is a leading global pure-play engineering research and development (ER&D) services company, providing consultancy, design, development and testing services across industrial products, medical devices, transportation, telecom, and process industries.

call_points.text: Reiterated long-term aspiration of 13-15% revenue CAGR and 16-17% EBIT margins over 3-5 years.

DSO improved to 78 days, well below the guided range of 80-85 days.
Management reaffirmed the 5-year aspiration of 13-15% CAGR revenue growth and 16-17% EBIT margins.
Company remains on track to achieve mid-16% EBIT margin on or before Q4 FY27.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal has been filed with CIT(A) on 23 January 2019 for small adjustments done by AO AY 2016-17. Due to procedural issue where DDT challans of Rs. 61 crores were not considered and Interest of Rs.22.8 crores was levied resulting into demand of Rs.84 crores, as shown on portal. Rectification with AO as well as CIT(A) for the matter have been filed.
tax_litigation.status: An appeal is pending before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). An expedition letter has been filed, and further communication from the Department is awaited. Rectification effect has since been given, pursuant to which the major portion of the demand has been dropped, and a refund is now expected.

operating_notes.text: LTTS released its Integrated Annual Report for FY26 showing consolidated revenue of ₹10,996 Cr and an unmodified audit opinion.
LTTS announced a global strategic partnership with Emerson to serve as a global System Integrator and establish a Centre of Excellence at its Mysuru campus.
LTTS opened its first Engineering Intelligence Center of Excellence in Munich, Germany.
Q1FY27 dollar revenue stood at $309.9 Mn, up 1.5% sequentially and 1.9% YoY in constant currency.
LTTS launched AgenticIQ, an end-to-end Agentic AI platform for engineering, manufacturing, and customer experience.
Secured a 5-year engagement valued at over $75 million from a global technology enterprise in the Tech Segment.
Completed sale of Smart World and Communication Business Unit to AMI Paradigm Solutions Private Limited on September 1, 2026.
LTTS partnered with Cognite to establish an Industrial AI Center of Excellence and certified 50+ engineers.
Inaugurated AI-Native EI Lab for Digital Manufacturing in Bengaluru featuring NVIDIA accelerated AI-native factory technologies.
Q2FY27 other expenses fell 20.8% YoY to ₹702.5 Cr, helping EBITDA margin reach 19.27% from 16.47%.
The SWC business unit sale to AMI Paradigm Solutions Private Limited concluded on September 1, 2026, with a net-of-tax gain of ₹165 Cr booked under discontinued operations.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was ₹558.8 Cr against EBITDA of ₹1,134.1 Cr.
Q2FY27 large deal TCV was $203 million, with over 50% being AI-led wins.
Engineering Intelligence (EI) annualized revenue reached $120 million in Q2FY27.
Offshore mix improved to 55.9% and fixed-price mix improved to 35.6% in Q2FY27.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,857.9 Cr, net profit ₹332.7 Cr (+7.3% YoY).
L&T Technology Services Limited held Q4 FY26 Earnings Conference Call on April 22, 2026, at 8:00 PM (IST), with recording available on its website.
L&T Technology Services reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,858 Cr with an EBIT margin of 15.2% and announced the disinvestment of the SWC business.
L&T Technology Services published its Integrated Annual Report for FY25-26 on May 9, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹10,996 Cr.
On May 12, 2026, L&T Technology Services announced a global cooperation and strategic partnership with Emerson to drive innovation in engineering excellence.
On May 20, 2026, L&T Technology Services announced the inauguration of its first Engineering Intelligence Center of Excellence in Munich, Germany.
On May 21, 2026, L&T Technology Services announced an ESG credit rating score of 80 assigned by ESG Risk Assessments & Insights Limited.
L&T Technology Services submitted the Scrutinizer's report for its 14th AGM, confirming all resolutions passed.
LTTS submitted an application to stock exchanges for the re-classification of Nabha Power Limited from promoter group to public category.
On July 14, 2026, LTTS held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call, reporting revenue of ₹2,940 Cr and an EBIT margin of 15.7%.
SES ESG Research independently revised L&T Technology Services' ESG score from 74.1 to 75.7.
On August 11, 2026, L&T Technology Services announced the launch of AgenticIQ, an end-to-end Agentic AI platform for engineering and manufacturing.
NSE Sustainability Ratings revised L&T Technology Services' ESG score from 74 to 75.
On August 17, 2026, LTTS submitted its investor presentation for an institutional roadshow in Singapore and Hong Kong.
On August 19, 2026, L&T Technology Services announced a 5-year engagement valued at over $75 million from a global technology enterprise.
LTTS completed the sale and transfer of its Smart World and Communication Business Unit to AMI Paradigm Solutions.
On September 4, 2026, LTTS received stock exchange no-objection letters for reclassifying Nabha Power Limited to the public category.
L&T Technology Services partnered with Cognite on September 24, 2026, to advance engineering intelligence with industrial AI.
L&T Technology Services Limited’s Board of Directors will consider an interim dividend for the half year ending September 30, 2026, on October 19, 2026.
On October 12, 2026, L&T Technology Services inaugurated its AI-Native EI Lab for Digital Manufacturing in Bengaluru, featuring NVIDIA accelerated technologies.
L&T Technology Services Limited’s **Prasad Shanbhag (M. No. A 30254)** announced Q2 FY27 earnings conference call on **October 19, 2026, at 17:30 IST** for investors/analysts.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,040.4 Cr, net profit ₹548.7 Cr (+66.7% YoY).
L&T Technology Services Limited held Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call on October 19, 2026, at 5:30 PM (IST), with recording available on the company’s website.
LTTS reported Q2FY27 results with 2.7% sequential CC revenue growth and achieved its mid-16% EBIT margin target ahead of schedule.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for re-appointment of Mr. Alind Saxena

watchlist.response: Attributed to a MedTech program concluding and its replacement being delayed; expects Tech to return to growth from Q2 but not to 34% levels.

status_history.evidence: Tech segment revenue fell 0.6% YoY to ₹901.9 Cr in Q2FY27, not returning to growth.

watchlist.text: Tech segment declined and now contributes 30.6% of revenue versus 34.4% a year ago; is this structural?

watchlist.response: Management clarified it was due to a medical program reaching conclusion and temporary delays, expecting growth to resume from Q2.

status_history.evidence: Tech segment remained steady, but European Auto headwinds persist with recovery expected in 9-12 months.

watchlist.text: Decline in Tech segment revenue and whether deal delays are broad-based.

watchlist.response: Management explained the segment is now split into four broad categories with redefined offerings and long-term relationships, reducing volatility.
watchlist.text: Volatility and annuity deal mix in the Sustainability segment.

watchlist.response: Management acknowledged headwinds but expects recovery in 9-12 months as OEMs finalize technology strategies for hybrid and AI-native solutions.
watchlist.text: Headwinds in European Auto and restructuring of German OEMs.
